const repoBase = "/" + window.location.pathname.split('/')[1]; // "/demotape-explorer" // Initialize map const map = L.map('map').setView([0,0], 12); // Raster tiles — point to built location L.tileLayer(`${repoBase}/static/maps/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png`, { minZoom: 8, maxZoom: 16, noWrap: true }).addTo(map); // Load GeoJSON points fetch(`${repoBase}/static/maps/data/points-ai.geojson?v=${Date.now()}`) .then(res => res.json()) .then(data => { const geoLayer = L.geoJSON(data, { pointToLayer: (feature, latlng) => L.marker(latlng), onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => { layer.on('click', () => { // Highlight marker if (activeMarker) activeMarker.getElement().classList.remove('active'); activeMarker = layer; layer.getElement().classList.add('active'); // Markdown path in built site const mdPath = `${repoBase}/static/maps/${feature.properties.content_file}?v=${Date.now()}`; fetch(mdPath) .then(r => r.text()) .then(md => { let html = marked.parse(md); // Fix image paths html = html.replace(/src="images\//g, `src="${repoBase}/static/maps/images/`); // Backlink const backlink = `
← Back to Knowledge Platform
`; document.getElementById('panel').innerHTML = ` ${backlink}

${feature.properties.title}

${html} `; }) .catch(err => { document.getElementById('panel').innerHTML = `
← Back to Knowledge Platform

${feature.properties.title}

Error loading content: ${err.message}

`; }); }); } }).addTo(map); if (geoLayer.getBounds().isValid()) map.fitBounds(geoLayer.getBounds()); });
